title: Wall Street closes mixed: Dow Jones rises 0.55% while Nasdaq falls on tech concerns and hopes for dialogue with Iran
summary: US stock indexes moved in opposite directions; the Dow Jones advanced on expectations of negotiations between the US and Iran, while the Nasdaq retreated due to caution in the technology sector.

title: Trump threatens tariffs on the European Union over Google fine
summary: The President of the United States announces a trade investigation against the EU for considering the penalty imposed on the tech giant Google 'illegal'.

title: Kevin Warsh promises a regime change at the Federal Reserve that could shake Wall Street
summary: The candidate to lead the Fed warns of a profound transformation in monetary policy, generating uncertainty in financial markets.

title: Oil falls below $100 on possible resumption of talks between US and Iran
summary: Crude oil cheapens on expectations of diplomatic dialogue that reduces geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, while gold rises.

title: Oil reaches $100 and triggers massive sell-off in global bonds
summary: The rise in crude oil prices triggers a collapse in debt markets and pressures Asian stock exchanges due to fears of persistent inflation.

title: Verizon cuts profit by 23% but raises forecasts and its shares rise on the stock market
summary: The telecommunications company reports worse-than-expected quarterly results, but improves its outlook for the year, boosting the stock price.

title: Sabadell rises 3.4% on the stock market driven by share buyback and its forecasts
summary: The Spanish bank leads the gains of the Ibex 35 after announcing a share buyback program and improving its business expectations.

title: Mapfre falls 4.7% on the stock market after being penalized for its acquisition in the US
summary: The Spanish insurer suffers the biggest drop in the Ibex 35 after the market punished its expansion in the US market.

title: The Ibex 35 closes the week near 19,600 points with a rise of 1.9%
summary: The main Spanish stock index accumulates a weekly gain of 1.9% supported by corporate earnings and the truce in tariff tensions.
